page.overview:
Who is Curt F. Danhauser?

Lieutenant Curt F. Danhauser was a Starfleet officer during the Dominion War.

In 2374, , Starbase 129 and Starbase 153 reported him wounded in action; however, the reported him missing in action and the reported him killed in action. His name was listed in a casualty list that was displayed in the wardroom of Deep Space 9. (, okudagram)
